title: Prompt Compressor Configuration
description: One config for every LLM the plugin is attached to. Named policies hold the compression settings; bindings pick a policy per LLM or App. An App can override its policy with the metadata key prompt_compressor.policy.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: off does nothing. audit compresses and records the savings but forwards the original body. enforce forwards the compressed body.

default_policy.title: Default policy
default_policy.description: The policy for requests no binding matches. "default" is level 1 on tool outputs when no policy of that name is defined; "off" turns compression off.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Named policies. Each one starts from the defaults and lists only what it changes. The name "off" is reserved.

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.description: Policy by LLM or App: keys llm:<slug>, llm_id:<id> or app:<id>, values a policy name or "off". Precedence: App metadata, app:, llm_id:, llm:, then the default policy.

allow_client_bypass.title: Allow client bypass
allow_client_bypass.description: Honour the request header X-Tyk-Compression: off.

failure_mode.title: Engine failure mode
failure_mode.description: What happens when an external engine call fails: open forwards the request, closed answers 502. Every other failure always passes the request through unchanged.

lossy_with_request_filters.title: Lossy levels with request filters
lossy_with_request_filters.description: Run level 3 and engines on LLMs that have request filters. Off by default, because the filters would screen the compressed body rather than the original.

max_body_bytes.title: Maximum body size (bytes)
max_body_bytes.description: Bodies larger than this pass through uncompressed. Limits are by size, never by time, so load never changes the output.

cache_drop_alert.title: Cache-drop warning
cache_drop_alert.description: The dashboard warns when the cache-read share falls by more than this fraction (0.25 is a quarter of its value before) within an hour of a policy change. 0 turns the warning off.

^engine_[a-z0-9]+(_[a-z0-9]+)*_(url|toke.description: Engine credentials, engine_<name>_url and engine_<name>_token, for a policy's external engine. Use a $SECRET/ reference.

level.title: Level
level.description: 0 off, 1 lossless, 2 noise reduction, 3 aggressive. Cumulative.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Which messages are compressed. Tool outputs by default.

protect_recent_turns.title: Protected recent turns
protect_recent_turns.description: The newest turns stay at level 1 at most, so the model reads its latest tool output in full.

cache_mode.title: Cache mode
cache_mode.description: deterministic compresses everything selected, the same way every turn. skip_cached leaves everything up to the last cache breakpoint alone.

dedupe_references.title: Replace repeated tool outputs with a reference
dedupe_references.description: A tool output identical to an earlier one in the same request becomes a reference to it.

tool_overrides.title: Per-tool overrides
tool_overrides.description: By tool name: exclude the tool, or set its level or size budget.

protect_patterns.title: Protect patterns
protect_patterns.description: Regular expressions (RE2) whose matches lossy levels keep verbatim, such as ticket IDs.

drop_tools.title: Drop tools
drop_tools.description: Tool definitions to remove from requests: a name, or a prefix ending in '*'. Tools the conversation already called, or that tool_choice names, are always kept. Changing the list is a one-off prompt-cache miss for the Apps it applies to.

max_unit_tokens.title: Maximum unit size (tokens, level 3)
max_unit_tokens.description: Level 3 cuts longer tool outputs to their head and tail, with a marker.

mask_after_turns.title: Mask after turns (level 3)
mask_after_turns.description: Level 3 replaces tool results older than this many turns with a placeholder; 0 turns masking off. Each masking step rewrites the vendor's prompt cache, so it pays where cached input is not much cheaper than input (OpenAI chat models with a 50% cache discount) and costs more than it saves where cache reads are very cheap (Anthropic, GPT-5). Off by default.

mask_step_tokens.title: Mask step (tokens, level 3)
mask_step_tokens.description: Level 3 masks old turns in steps of at least this many tokens, so each one-off cache rewrite buys a large saving.

engine.title: External engine
engine.description: Sends selected units to an external engine (Headroom /v1/compress or LLMLingua-2) after levels 1–3; failure_mode decides what an engine failure does. Credentials come from engine_<name>_url and engine_<name>_token.
